crossrefs.text: What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?
But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their childrenʼs children—
but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be uprooted.
Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
Life and death are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
The tongue also is a fire, a world of wickedness among the parts of the body. It pollutes the whole person, sets the course of his life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.

groups.title: Kings, prophets and the house of David

crossrefs.text: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,
His shoots will sprout, and his splendor will be like the olive tree, his fragrance like the cedars of Lebanon.
O Ephraim, what have I to do anymore with idols? It is I who answer and watch over him. I am like a flourishing cypress; your fruit comes from Me.
He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.
But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.
The LORD once called you a flourishing olive tree, beautiful with well-formed fruit. But with a mighty roar He will set it on fire, and its branches will be consumed.

For if you were cut from a wild olive tree, and contrary to nature were grafted into one that is cultivated, how much more readily will these, the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree!
